methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from official vendor pricing pages via WebFetch on 2026-06-14 and independently re-verified on 2026-06-14. Contentful prices are EUR on their pricing page (Lite €300/mo); GetApp lists the USD self-serve price as $300/month for Lite, which is the figure used. Sanity Free $0 / Growth $15-per-seat / Enterprise custom confirmed from sanity.io/pricing. Storyblok Growth $99/mo and Growth Plus $349/mo confirmed (annual $90.75 / $319.91 via the 'one month free' model, ~8.3% discount). Strapi Cloud: the official page is JS-rendered and returns no figures, but the current self-serve tiers (Free $0, Essential $18, Pro $90, Scale $450, 20% annual discount) are confirmed via Strapi's own blog and costbench.com — corrected from a prior version that listed an invented 'Team' plan with null prices. Hygraph Hobby $0 / Growth $199 / Enterprise custom confirmed. Prismic prices are per-repository, billed annually (Free $0, Starter $10, Small $25, Medium $150, Platinum $675), confirmed from prismic.io/pricing. Directus Core $0 / Team $499 annual ($599 monthly, ~17% discount) / Open Innovation Grant $99 / Enterprise custom confirmed from directus.com/pricing. Builder.io Free $0 confirmed; Pro and Team per-user prices are rendered as images on the official page and no single credible current self-serve figure could be confirmed, so they remain null with a provenance note. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null for all plans as this is a non-telephony vertical.
